seoTitle: Add a Gallery Block in Squarespace
metaDescription: Learn how to add and resize an image gallery block on your Squarespace site, including slideshow options and adding video to a gallery.
intro: A gallery block on Squarespace lets you showcase multiple images together, with options for a grid or slideshow layout. This guide covers adding the block, uploading images, and resizing it to fit your page design.

steps.heading: Open the page editor
steps.body: Go to the page where you want the gallery and click Edit to start adding content.

steps.heading: Add a gallery block
steps.body: Click the plus button to add a new block and select the Gallery option from the block menu.

steps.heading: Upload your images
steps.body: Add the images you want to display, in the order you'd like them to appear in the gallery.

steps.heading: Choose a layout style
steps.body: Pick between a grid or slideshow display depending on how you want the gallery to present your images.

steps.heading: Resize the gallery block
steps.body: Adjust the block's dimensions so it fits well within your page layout.

steps.heading: Add video if needed
steps.body: Some gallery blocks also support adding video alongside images for a mixed media display.

faq.question: Can I use a slideshow layout for my gallery?
faq.answer: Yes, Squarespace gallery blocks support both grid and slideshow display styles.

faq.question: Can I resize a gallery block after adding it?
faq.answer: Yes, you can adjust the gallery block's size to fit your page layout after it's been added.

faq.question: Can I add video to a gallery block?
faq.answer: Yes, some gallery block configurations support adding video alongside your images.

faq.question: Does this work the same on Squarespace 7.1?
faq.answer: Yes, the gallery block is available and works similarly on Squarespace 7.1 templates.

faq.question: How many images can I add to a gallery block?
faq.answer: You can add multiple images to a single gallery block, arranged in the order you prefer.
